description: DRAFT industry rubric pack CHEMICAL_PHARMA: HIRA calibration v2 evaluation fixtures for an Indian API / bulk-drug plant. 5 activities: 2 low-hazard (CHEM-01, CHEM-02) and 3 high-hazard (CHEM-03..CHEM-05). Same structure as tests/eval/hira_calibration/activities.json: for DRAFT activities the per-hazard likelihood/severity are what an uncalibrated LLM (the v1 Copilot) proposed, often over-stated; recommendedControls are the controls it proposed. Hazards are seeds for the HSE lead to validate. 'expected' is an HSE judgement still to be made ('TODO(HSE lead)'); it must not be fitted to engine output.

STD_5X5.note: Standard 5x5, frequency-anchored likelihood, MODERATE tolerable with ALARP.

JSL_QSD24_GT.note: JSL Hisar plant method QSD/24 (GT > 3.33 significant): plant-index likelihood, MODERATE not acceptable.

activities.title: QC laboratory sample preparation and HPLC mobile phase
activities.activity: Weighing, dilution and titration of samples and preparation of HPLC mobile phases (methanol, acetonitrile, buffer) in the QC wet-chemistry laboratory

hazards.name: Solvent vapour while preparing mobile phase
hazards.consequence: Analyst breathes methanol / acetonitrile vapour while filtering and degassing 2 L of mobile phase on the open bench: headache and dizziness

hazards.name: Acid splash during dilution
hazards.consequence: Concentrated sulphuric acid splashes into the analyst's eye while diluting it for a titration reagent: chemical eye burn

hazards.name: Broken glassware
hazards.consequence: Pipette or volumetric flask neck breaks while fitting a bulb or stopper: hand laceration

hazards.name: Hot oven trays and hot plates
hazards.consequence: Analyst touches a 105 C loss-on-drying oven tray or a hot plate: minor contact burn

existingControls.description: Ducted fume hoods for all solvent and acid work
existingControls.verificationMethod: Quarterly face-velocity test (0.4-0.6 m/s) recorded on the hood label

existingControls.description: Eyewash at every bench row and a safety shower in the laboratory
Lab safety SOP QC-SOP-014: acids diluted only in the fume hood (acid into water); mobile phase prepared in the hood
Lab coat, safety goggles, nitrile gloves; heat-resistant gloves and tongs at the ovens

recommendedControls.description: Lab safety training
Face shield for acid dilution
Solvent safety cans and closed mobile-phase reservoirs with vent filters
Inspect glassware for chips before use; broken-glass bin at each bench
Bench-top spill kits

activities.title: Cleaning in place (CIP) of the reactor train
activities.activity: Running the automated CIP cycle (2% caustic soda at 75 C, then 1% nitric acid) for the reactor, receiver and transfer lines from the CIP skid, changing swing bends on the transfer panel and topping up the dosing tanks from carboys

hazards.name: Caustic splash at the swing bend
hazards.consequence: Hot residual caustic sprays the operator's face when a swing bend on the transfer panel is opened before the line has drained: chemical eye and face burns

hazards.name: Nitric acid fumes while topping up
hazards.consequence: Operator breathes nitric acid fumes while pouring from 35 L carboys into the acid dosing tank: respiratory irritation

hazards.name: Hot CIP supply lines
hazards.consequence: Hand contact with uninsulated 75-80 C CIP supply lines and the heat exchanger at the skid: contact burn

hazards.name: Wet floor around the CIP skid
hazards.consequence: Slip on the wet, caustic-contaminated floor around the CIP skid: fall, wrist fracture

existingControls.description: Automated CIP skid with closed circuits; cycle started and monitored from the HMI
Proximity switches on the swing-bend panel interlocked with the CIP supply pump
Carboy tilting trolley for topping up the dosing tanks
Eyewash and safety shower at the CIP skid
Face shield over chemical goggles, PVC apron, rubber gloves, gumboots

recommendedControls.description: Training on CIP chemicals and SDS
Insulate the CIP supply lines
Bulk caustic and acid dosing by metering pump instead of carboys
Acid gas respirator while topping up acid
Anti-slip chemical-resistant flooring at the skid
Confirm drain and zero flow on the HMI before opening a swing bend

activities.title: Solvent transfer and drumming at the solvent recovery plant
activities.activity: Pumping recovered toluene and methanol from the solvent recovery receiver into 200 L MS drums through a hose, and moving the full drums to the solvent yard

hazards.name: Static ignition at the drum bung
hazards.consequence: Splash filling through the top bung into an unearthed drum builds a static charge and the spark ignites toluene vapour at the bung: flash fire or drum explosion, severe burns to the operator

hazards.name: Drum overflow / hose slipping out
hazards.consequence: Drum overfills or the hose jumps out of the bung and 20-30 L of toluene spill over the operator's legs and the drumming floor: skin irritation, slip, and a pool that can ignite

hazards.name: Solvent vapour at the open bung
hazards.consequence: Operator bends over the open bung to watch the level and breathes toluene vapour: dizziness and narcosis; chronic neurotoxic effects over years

hazards.name: Handling full drums
hazards.consequence: Full 200 L drums (about 180 kg) are rolled and tipped upright by hand: crushed toes, fingers trapped between drums, back injury

recommendedControls.description: Earthing clamp with a static-earth indicator on every drum before filling
Dip pipe to the drum bottom (bottom filling) with a flow-meter cut-off
Flameproof pump and local exhaust at the drumming point
Drum trolley and hydraulic drum lifter
Training
Nitrile gloves and organic vapour respirator

items: NM-2026-0291: toluene drum overflowed at the SRS-2 drumming point, about 15 L on the floor, no ignition

activities.notes: Only baseline PPE recorded for the drumming point.

activities.title: Manhole charging of powder into a solvent-filled reactor
activities.activity: Charging 1,000 kg of a solid intermediate in 25 kg bags through the open manhole of a 6 KL SS reactor containing methanol, from the reactor-top platform
activities.llmStyle: WORST_CASE_ALL (v1: L4 x S5 on every hazard)

hazards.name: Flash fire at the open manhole
hazards.consequence: Static from powder poured out of a plastic-lined bag ignites methanol vapour at the open manhole: flash fire, severe burns to the charging operator's face and arms

hazards.name: Solvent vapour and powder dust at the manhole
hazards.consequence: Operator breathes methanol vapour and intermediate dust rising from the open manhole during charging: dizziness, respiratory sensitisation

hazards.name: Running agitator below the manhole
hazards.consequence: Operator breaking a lump with a scoop or by hand through the open manhole contacts the running agitator: arm drawn in, amputation

hazards.name: Nitrogen-blanketed reactor
hazards.consequence: Operator leans his head into the nitrogen-blanketed reactor through the manhole to check the powder level: collapses from oxygen deficiency and can fall in, fatal

hazards.name: Lifting bags to the manhole
hazards.consequence: Operator lifts 40 bags of 25 kg per batch from the pallet to the manhole rim: lower-back and shoulder strain

existingControls.description: Reactor, charging chute, platform and bag pallet bonded and earthed; operators wear antistatic footwear on a conductive platform
existingControls.verificationMethod: Earthing continuity check (< 10 ohm) logged each shift

existingControls.description: Reactor nitrogen-inerted; oxygen below 8% confirmed before the manhole is opened
existingControls.verificationMethod: O2 analyser reading recorded in the batch production record

existingControls.description: Manhole safety grill, interlocked to stop the agitator when the grill is lifted
Local exhaust ventilation ring at the manhole
Charging SOP PRD-SOP-021: antistatic (Type C / D) liners only, slow pouring, no head inside the manhole
Antistatic coverall, half-face respirator with organic vapour / P3 cartridge, chemical goggles, nitrile gloves

recommendedControls.description: Closed powder transfer system or split butterfly valve for charging
Vacuum bag lifter at the charging platform
Training on static electricity hazards
SCBA kept at the reactor platform
Oxygen monitor with alarm at the manhole
Safety awareness programme

items: NM-2025-0466: blue flash seen at the R-104 manhole while charging from a non-antistatic liner, no injury

activities.title: Multi-milling, sifting and FBD discharge of dried API
activities.activity: Unloading dried API from the fluid bed dryer (FBD) bowl, sizing it through the multi-mill and vibro-sifter and filling it into double-PE-lined drums in the milling room

hazards.name: Combustible dust explosion in the mill, sifter or FBD
hazards.consequence: Fine dry API dust (low minimum ignition energy) in the multi-mill, sifter or FBD filter bag is ignited by a static spark or tramp metal hitting the beater blades: dust deflagration bursts the equipment, burns and flying parts injure the operators in the milling room

hazards.name: Potent API dust
hazards.consequence: Operator breathes potent API dust while scooping product from the FBD bowl and tipping it into the mill hopper: pharmacological effects or sensitisation

hazards.name: Multi-mill beater blades
hazards.consequence: Operator pushes lumps down the mill hopper by hand and reaches the rotating beater blades: finger or hand amputation

hazards.name: Hot FBD bowl
hazards.consequence: Operator touches the 60-70 C FBD bowl and retarding chamber while unloading straight after drying: minor contact burn

hazards.name: Mill and sifter noise
hazards.consequence: Operators stand 3-4 hours beside the multi-mill and vibro-sifter at about 90 dB(A): noise-induced hearing loss

recommendedControls.description: Earthing and bonding of the mill, sifter, FBD and drums
Explosion vents or suppression on the FBD and mill
Magnetic grill at the mill inlet
Closed vacuum transfer from the FBD to the mill
Powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR) for milling
Training

existingControlProposals.description: Mill, sifter, FBD bowl and product drums bonded to an earthing relay that interlocks the mill motor
existingControlProposals.verificationMethod: Earthing relay check recorded at batch start

existingControlProposals.description: PAPR with hood and disposable coverall for open handling of OEB-4 products

openCapas.text: Explosion vent ducted outside the building on the FBD-3 filter housing

activities.notes: No controls captured in the draft (new milling suite); the plant registers hold two and there is an open CAPA.
